description: Multi-system emulator (SNES, NES, Mega Drive, PC Engine, Game Boy/GBA, MSX, WonderSwan, Neo Geo Pocket and more) by byuu
notes: This emulator is no longer developed; it was merged back into higan (see also ares).
Some systems (Famicom Disk System, Mega CD, GBA, Neo Geo Pocket) need BIOS files; set their paths in Settings > Firmware.
